# dsh-work-crew

One prompt. A working team.
一个指令。一支有纪律的本机 AI 班组。
简体中文 · English

`dsh-work-crew` is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that turns the AI apps already
installed on your machin
e — Doubao, WorkBuddy, ZCode, Qoder — into a **crew with a task board**.
DSH stays the orchestrator. It does not write your code itself; it plans, dispatches, enforces locks

,
collects receipts and keeps the books. The crew does the typing.
## Why
One model reviewing its own work is the weakest link in every AI coding session:
| Failure | What the crew does instead |
| **Self-review blind spot** — the model checks its own output | A different model reviews it; the i

mplementer never signs off on itself |
| **Concurrent edits** — writing and reviewing the same file

at once | Artifact locks: `write:landing:hero` and `read:landing` cannot overlap in time |
| **Lost
progress** — who is waiting for whom, asked again next session | A task board on disk (`.dsh-team/`)
with dependencies, locks and timeline |

## Tools
| Tool | When to use |

| `team_init` | first time in a project; records reference dirs and required docs |
| `team_status`

| who runs what, queue depth, last activity, held locks |
| `team_add_task` | declare worker, depend

encies, locks, deadline, expected artifacts |
| `team_dispatch` | send a brief; **takes `taskIds` to

dispatch several in one step**; queues when a worker is busy |
| `team_collect` | wait for receipts

: `taskIds` returns whoever finishes first |
| `team_reassign` | move a task to another worker, keep

ing brief and history |
| `team_reopen` | a false completion → back to running, without re-sending |

| `team_resubmit` | artifacts now exist → re-check expect instead of re-dispatching |
| `team_relea

se` | close a task (refuses `done` while expected artifacts are missing) |
| `team_split_html` | spl

it a single-file page into html/css/js so three workers can edit in parallel |
| `team_shot` | scree

nshot to a file, path only — device emulation for mobile widths |
| `team_workers` | status / prefli
ght / restart / ping |
## Workers
| id | App | Good at | Debug port |

| `workbuddy` | WorkBuddy | implementing, running commands, verifying builds | 9332 |
| `doubao` | D

oubao | visual review, ideas, reading screenshots | 9331 |
| `zcode` | ZCode | implementation / seco

nd opinion (limited free quota) | 9334 |
| `qoder` | Qoder | implementation / read-only audits (VS C
ode family) | 9335 |
## How it works
- **Driven over CDP.** The plugin launches each app with `--remote-debugging-port` and types into it

s chat box.
Windows can stay offscreen; nothing steals your mouse.
- **Completion is a hard signal.*

* WorkBuddy's "已完成" badge; Doubao/ZCode/Qoder's `@@END@@` sentinel.
No guessing from text stillness.

- **File handoff.** Workers write reports to `.dsh-team/outbox/<id>.md` and reply with one line.
Th

e body never enters the orchestrator's context — that is where the token savings come from.
- **Lock

s with hierarchy.** `landing` covers `landing:hero`; siblings (`hero`, `meta`) run in parallel.
- **
Queue, not stuck.** A busy worker queues the task (`queued`, no locks, no timeout) and promotes it w

hen the
current one is collected.
- **Budget.** `deadlineMin` (default 45) flags a stalled task; at

twice the budget it is blocked and its locks released.
- **Artifacts are checked.** `expect` paths m
ust exist before a task counts as done; the outbox file is added automatically.
## Screenshots: two traps that produce false reviews
Use `team_shot` — it already avoids both traps and returns only a path:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
**Trap 1 — capturing mid-animation.** A headless shot without a virtual clock lands on the fade-in,

so the page looks
half-transparent. `team_shot` emulates `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` and waits
for the layout to settle.
**Trap 2 — resizing the window instead of emulating the device.** `--window-size=390,844` sets the *

window*, but the
layout keeps the desktop viewport (~980px), so the shot is a cropped desktop page.

That reads as "the layout overflows"
and sends a reviewer chasing a bug that does not exist. Device

emulation is the only honest mobile shot, and
`team_shot` checks `scrollWidth` for you: if it equals
the viewport, the layout is fine.
## Guardrails
Six checks stand between "the model says it is done" and "the task is done":
| Guard | What it does |
| `review: true` | The reviewer gets **requirement + `git diff` + rubric only**. It is told not to r
ead the implementer's report — a reviewer that inherits the author's narrative inherits the author's

blind spots. |
| Snapshot review | The changed files are copied to `.dsh-team/snapshots/<id>/` and
the reviewer reads **the copy**, so the review takes no read lock and the next implementation starts
immediately. Diffing starts from the implementer's recorded `baseCommit`, so committed work still s

hows up. |
| `verify: "pnpm build"` | The acceptance command runs in the project before the task may

close. A red build blocks the task; no green build, no done. |
| `risk: "high"` | High-risk work (a
uth, payments, CI, secrets, installers) **never self-approves**: collecting it only reports "awaitin

g approval" until a human re-collects with `confirm: true`. |
[该节后续省略]
## Knowledge base
"Make it look good" produces nothing. "Look at this, apply it like so, ship when these three rules h
old" changes the output.
[该节后续省略]
## Requirements

- Windows with DSH Desktop (or DSH Web + Node 22+).
- At least one of the four apps installed and **

logged in**.
- In each app: select the project folder as its workspace, and allow auto-approval / fu

ll access.
- The plugin launches the apps itself; an app already running without a debug port must b

e restarted
(`team_workers {"action":"restart","worker":"doubao"}`), which is also the fix when a po
team_workers {"action":"restart","worker":"doubao"}`), which is also the fix when a port goes stale.
